Return only a concise decision brief with evidence bullets, contradictions, data gaps, and thesis invalidation. Do not expose hidden chain-of-thought. Before finalizing, explicitly self-criticize the trade idea by checking evidence for LONG, evidence for SHORT, evidence for WAIT/FLAT, stale or missing data, and what would invalidate the directional view. If evidence conflicts, prefer WAIT/FLAT.
